normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents…“Somerset Cottage,” a professionally designed single-level retreat in Rosemary Beach! Enjoy access to 4 community pools, scenic bike rides with 4 bikes provided, and a spacious private courtyard amongst lush greenery - perfect for relaxing after the day exploring 30A. With modern style and unique decor Somerset Cottage is the ideal family getaway for up to 8 guests. Learn more below…👇 *** HIGHLIGHTS ***3-Min Walk to the Cabana Pool.Quick bike ride to the beach.Private Courtyard - Relax and gather in your spacious outdoor living area4 Rosemary Community Pools - Enjoy exclusive access to your choice of heated, lap, and children's poolsBikes Provided - Enjoy 4 adult cruiser bikes available for guests.Chef's Kitchen - Fully equipped with stainless steel appliances and modern finishesBright and Spacious Interiors - Open floor plan with 10-ft ceilings and stylish West Elm-inspired décorEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐“We loved the courtyard as a space for our toddler to play. The home was spotlessly clean and perfectly located.” - Shaila W.⭐“The bikes were such a fun bonus! The kids loved riding to the beach and exploring nearby greens.” - Dylan B.⭐“Beautiful home! It was in a great spot for quick walks to the pool. We will be back again!” - Susan T.*** LIVING AREAS ***Somerset Cottage’s thoughtfully designed interior welcomes you with an open floor plan, 10-foot ceilings, and chic West Elm-inspired décor. The living room is comfortable and inviting, featuring plush seating, a large couch, oversized chair, ottoman, and two additional armchairs, perfect for hosting a movie night or sharing conversations.Open and airy living space with ample seatingLarge flat-screen TV for entertainment*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook like a pro or enjoy takeout in style with a vibrant chef’s kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, premium solid surface countertops, and all the cookware you’ll need. A chic dining area with seating for 6 ensures mealtime is always a highlight of the day.Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliancesDining table seating for 6*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step outside into your private courtyard oasis. Whether you're sipping coffee in the covered seating area, grilling up a feast on the propane grill, or basking on the sunny patio, this space is perfect for creating memories.Spacious courtyard with seating and dining space for 6Propane grill for al fresco cookingCovered outdoor living area*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary King Suite - King bed with flat-screen TV, adjoining En-suite featuring dual vanities and a luxurious walk-in showerFront Queen Guest Suite - Queen bed with natural light pouring in from the courtyard entry, flat-screen TV for your entertainment and Shared En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboRear Queen Guest Suite - Queen bed, direct courtyard access and flat-screen TV for your entertainmentBunk Nook - Adorable twin bunk beds tucked in the main hallway*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Situated in the heart of Rosemary Beach, "Somerset Cottage" places you at the center of it all. You’ll be steps away from St. Augustine Green, moments from the Cabana Pool, and a quick walk or bike ride to the stunning Gulf Coast beaches. Explore boutique shops and enjoy dining in award-winning restaurants.Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountains3-Minute Walk to Cabana Pool4-minute bike ride to the beach access5 Minute Walk to Fitness Center, Heated Sky Pool and Tennis Courts4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.Outdoor fireplace is not for guest use.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
